trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The raider has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the raider's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Smackback
entries: {@actTrigger} The raider takes damage from a creature within 5 feet. {@actResponse} The raider makes one Pummel attack, targeting the triggering creature.
